title: Automate Invoicing & Payment Reminders in Zoho Books #Shorts
description:
SMEDAN and Zoho are offering wallet credits for Zoho apps, including Zoho Books, to 25,000 Nigerian MSMEs. Here is what to automate first: recurring invoices, automatic payment reminders and online payments.

1. Go to Sales › Invoices and click New Recurring Invoice to set billing schedules
2. Go to Settings › Reminders and switch on automated payment reminders
3. Go to Settings › Online Payments and connect a payment gateway so clients pay from the invoice

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation
